from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PublicRoute:
    pattern: str
    # When set, the path must have the same number of segments as the pattern,
    # so a star cannot reach into nested folders (e.g. drafts) for this route.
    exact_depth: bool = False

    def allows(self, path: str) -> bool:
        if self.exact_depth and path.count("/") != self.pattern.count("/"):
            return False
        return True


DEFAULT_ROUTES = (PublicRoute("/teams/*/badge.png", exact_depth=True),)
EOF

def test_default_badge_route_does_not_reach_nested_folders():
    service = AssetService({
        "/teams/west/badge.png": b"PNG",
        "/teams/west/drafts/badge.png": b"draft",
    })
    assert service.fetch("/teams/west/badge.png") == (200, b"PNG")
    assert service.fetch("/teams/west/drafts/badge.png")[0] == 403
    assert not service.is_public("/teams/west/drafts/badge.png")
EOF
